content.headline: US Withdraws from Paris Agreement
content.body: The United States has officially withdrawn from the Paris Agreement, marking a significant shift in global climate policy. The decision, confirmed by administration officials, means the US will no longer participate in the international accord aimed at combating climate change. This move fulfills a long-standing promise to exit the agreement, which the administration has criticized for its economic impact. The withdrawal takes effect immediately, and the US will cease all related reporting and financial contributions. Environmental groups have condemned the decision, while supporters argue it protects American jobs and sovereignty. The US now joins a small group of nations not party to the accord.
